newsitem.title: USA: Knogo, Video Sentry to merge.
newsitem.headline: Knogo, Video Sentry to merge.

text.p: Knogo North America Inc said late Thrusday that it has signed a definitive agreement top merge with Video Sentry Corp, resulting in a new publicly traded entity to be called Sentry Technology Corp.
Knogo said the merger agreement provides for Sentry, a newly formed Delaware corporation, to issue one share of common stock for each share of Video Sentry common stock.
Sentry will issue one share of common stock and one share of Class A Preferred Stock for each 1.2022 shares of Knogo common stock outstanding, Knogo said.

Following consummation of the merger, it is anticipated that there will be about 9.6 million shares of Sentry common stock, 51 percent owned by former Video Sentry shareholders and 49 percent owned by former Knogo holders.
There will be 4.8 million shares of Sentry Class A Preferred Stock outstanding, all owned by former Knogo shareholders, the company said.
Knogo said its president and chief executive officer, Thomas Nicolette, will be the CEO of Sentry.
